text: Order A-1001 shipped from Toronto; the customer asked support to make sure it goes to the concierge.
The customer changed the delivery address of order A-1002 while it was still processing.
The customer asked how to return order A-1003, a Trailhead 28 backpack in moss; support explained the 30 day return window.
A parcel arrived 4 business days late; support opened a carrier trace and the customer kept the order.
